subject: PO ownership & banking transition for Sunnova — next steps
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@sunnova.co>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Vendor bank update + PO routing question

Hi Rishi / Laura,

Quick note from Sunnova — our treasury team changed primary banking partners as of Jan 1 and wants Redwood to pay to the new account. We've attached the signed bank letter and updated vendor onboarding worksheet for your records (sunnova_bank_letter_signed.pdf, sunnova_vendor_onboard_form.xlsx).

Two questions where we need your help:
- When the vendor record is updated in your system, will existing open POs automatically route to the new payee/bank, or do we need a PO-level reassignment?
- Is there a Redwood procurement/ops task we should expect to see (ticket/hubspot/DocuSign) to authorize the change?

We'd like an effective change date of Feb 1 to avoid a mid-cycle disruption. Please confirm next steps and any additional docs required.

Thanks,
Carlos Mendez
Head of Finance Operations
Sunnova Inc.
Attachments: sunnova_bank_letter_signed.pdf (PDF), sunnova_vendor_onboard_form.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@sunnova.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor bank update + PO routing question

Hi Carlos — thanks for the docs, and for the clear effective date. Short answer: we can update the vendor remit/bank info and route future invoices to the new account; open POs may require a brief PO ownership/routing reconciliation to ensure the AP system maps the existing PO-to-supplier relationship to the updated payee/bank.

To get this done cleanly we need three items from you:
1) Completed vendor_onboard_form.xlsx (you sent a draft — please confirm all fields, esp. EIN and remittance address).
2) Bank letter on company letterhead with a treasury contact (we have the signed copy but need a scanned company-letterhead version for our records).
3) Confirmation of the legal payee name you want on POs (e.g., "Sunnova Inc." vs "Sunnova Trading LLC").

Once we have those, I will:
- Kick off a procurement change request (PROC-78421) and tag AP for a PO routing review.
- Ask Laura to validate the tax/EIN info and schedule a test ACH if required.
- Put a hold on any automated vendor merge tasks until we confirm the payee name.

If Feb 1 is the desired go-live, please send the three items by EOD Jan 24 so we can hit the timeline.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Procurement (on behalf of Vendor Operations)
Redwood Inference

Hi Carlos — Laura from AP here. I reviewed the vendor_onboard_form and bank letter: thank you, they look in order. A couple items before we flip the switch on Feb 1:

1) We need the signed ACH authorization via DocuSign (I attached the PO-routing-change-template.docx for your legal team to review prior to signing). Once signed we run a small test ACH (<$1) to the account you provided.
2) Please confirm whether your invoicing will reference the new legal payee name ("Sunnova Trading LLC") on all invoices going forward — that makes auto-matching easier. If invoices continue to use the old payee, we'll need a short mapping table.
3) For the three open POs (PO-4521, PO-4592, PO-4620) I will open a PO reassignment ticket and mark them for manual review so payments scheduled in Feb hit the new bank. Expect a follow-up ticket from PROC-ops by EOD Jan 29.

Once DocuSign is complete and test ACH clears, we will mark the vendor record as updated and finish the PO routing changes.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. AP Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: po-routing-change-template.docx (DOCX)

Carlos — thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming the payee name. Final confirmation and next steps: 

- Procurement has opened PROC-78421 and assigned it to ops for PO reassignment.
- Laura will send the DocuSign ACH envelope to your treasury contact this afternoon: https://docusign.com/envelopes/0a1b2c3d
- AP will initiate a micro-ACH test after the envelope is signed (target: 48 hours). Once the test is accepted we will change the vendor remit and close the PO reassignment tickets.
- Expected go-live for payment routing: Feb 4 (allows two business days after DocuSign completion and one bank business day for the micro-ACH). If you need Feb 1 specifically, we can accelerate but would require signed DocuSign by EOD Feb 2.

Open items for Sunnova:
- Confirm DocuSign signer (name & email) for ACH authorization.
- Confirm that all new invoices will use "Sunnova Trading LLC" as the remit/payee name or provide a mapping table.

I'll keep this thread for audit trail; Laura/Tessa will follow up with the PROC ticket and test-ACH confirmation. Thanks again for coordinating.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Procurement
